trigger-summon.title: Summon
trigger-summon.text: When this unit comes into play.

lifesteal.title: Lifesteal
lifesteal.text: When this damages the enemy hero, give your hero that much health.

ready.title: Ready
ready.text: If this character is sleeping, or has already attacked this turn, it can attack again.

trigger-play.title: Play
trigger-play.text: When this unit is played from hand.

inspire.title: Inspire
inspire.text: An effect that will trigger after you play a certain card.

trigger-inspire-guard.title: Inspire {Guard}
trigger-inspire-guard.text: After you play a card with {Guard}.

scion.title: Scion
scion.text: Any Unit with Scion in its name.

trigger-inspire-banner.title: Inspire {Banner}
trigger-inspire-banner.text: After you play a card with {Banner}.

trigger-slay-unit.title: Slay
trigger-slay-unit.text: When this Unit damages and destroys a unit during your turn.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.text: A sleeping character cannot attack. Units are asleep when first summoned.

trigger-death.title: Death
trigger-death.text: When this is put into a graveyard from the battlefield.

trigger-sunset.title: Sunset
trigger-sunset.text: When this unit or enchant's player's turn ends.

rune.title: Rune
rune.text: A 1 cost spell with banner that attaches an enchant to a unit. There is one for each element.

wither.title: Wither
wither.text: When this damages a unit, that unit loses that much power.

enchanted.title: Enchanted
enchanted.text: The character this enchant is attached to.

blade.title: Blade
blade.text: All Spells with 'Blade' in their name.

trigger-slay-spell.title: Slay
trigger-slay-spell.text: When this Spell damages and destroys a unit during your turn.

enemydraw.title: Enemy Draw
enemydraw.text: Draw a card from the enemy deck, if possible. If not, lose 1 health and Conjure one from their Prism(s) instead.

trait.title: Traits
trait.text: Guard, stealth, armor, banner, lifesteal, wither, and dash.

trigger-sunrise.title: Sunrise
trigger-sunrise.text: When this unit or enchant's player's turn starts.

trigger-inspire-spell.title: Inspire Spell
trigger-inspire-spell.text: After you play a Spell card.

dash.title: Dash
dash.text: This unit can attack enemy units the turn it is summoned, or if it was sleeping and gained dash.

banner-unit.title: Banner
banner-unit.text: Your hero gains +1 power while this unit is in play.

stealth.title: Stealth
stealth.text: This unit can't be attacked unless its hero has been damaged this turn.

banner-spell.title: Banner
banner-spell.text: Your hero gains +1 power this turn.

conjure.title: Conjure
conjure.text: Draw a card that is in your Prism(s), from outside of your deck.

enemyconjure.title: Conjure Enemy Card
enemyconjure.text: Draw a card that is in the enemy Prism(s), from outside of their deck.

wisp.title: Wisp
wisp.text: Any Unit with Wisp in its name.

mulligan.title: Mulligan
mulligan.text: Return card(s) from hand to deck, then draw the same number of cards.

guard.title: Guard
guard.text: This unit's hero can't be attacked.

play.title: Play Effects
play.text: Effects that trigger when a unit is played from hand.

draw.title: Draw
draw.text: Draw a card from your deck, if possible. If not, lose 1 health and Conjure one instead.

trigger-glory.title: Glory
trigger-glory.text: When this character attacks a hero and damages them.

lowesthealth.title: Lowest Health
lowesthealth.text: Chosen randomly from the lowest health targets in the case of a tie.

shroom.title: Shroom
shroom.text: 'Fun Guy' and all Units with 'Shroom' in their name.
